steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each item is matched to its justification and its source. A cost or payback with no source is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Item with no justification
findings.fix: Justify the item or drop it

findings.title: Payback with no basis
findings.fix: State the basis for the payback

outcome.notChecked: Whether the investment is needed beyond the justification given.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[high] capex-line-4.md:12  Item with no justification.

[medium] capex-controls.md:19  Cost with no source.
       Fix: Attach the quote.
[low] capex-meter.md:26  Payback with no basis.

Not checked: Whether the investment is needed beyond the justification given.
pros: Checks an item with no justification, a cost with no source, and a payback with no basis.
cons: Not checked: Whether the investment is needed beyond the justification given.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-capex-plan skill on the records for this review.
